summary: One cutscene scene: owns the scene definition record, the scene pack handle and its 8-byte resource-handle vector, the embedded Anim_ModelInstance that drives the cutscene camera/actor animation, the BGM handle and the message flag. Allocated by Field_InitSceneObjects (0x0019CD50) and stored at Field_Scene+0x70; driven by Ui_SceneFlow_Update through Cutscene_UpdateTimer.
evidence: Cutscene_Scene_Init (0x003984B8) stamps vtable 0x00766E7C and initialises every field; Field_InitSceneObjects (0x0019CD50) allocates 0x210 bytes with Mem_AllocAligned_2 and passes the block to Cutscene_Scene_Init, so the object is 0x210 bytes (the batch's 416 is only the highest field + width). Cutscene_Teardown (0x00397984) resets the same offsets. The batch omits +0xC (u16 scene id) and +0x14 (u8 flag) that the ctor writes, and the tail +0x1C4..+0x210 (camera step index at +0x1CC, message flag at +0x20C) is outside the batch.

fields.name: vtable
fields.evidence: Cutscene_Scene_Init stores 0x00766E7C (literal pool 0x003985F8) and Cutscene_Scene_Dtor re-stores it; the slots are Cutscene_CreateActorModels, Cutscene_ApplyLayoutMode, Cutscene_AttachMantleToActor, Cutscene_FindResourceEntry and Cutscene_OpenMessageForActor

fields.name: maybe_secondaryVtable
fields.evidence: ctor stores the shared rodata constant 0x00782234 (literal 0x003985FC); Anim_Sequence_CtorBase stores the same constant at +0xC and 292 functions reference it, and the table at 0x00782234 is a function-pointer table with mostly null slots, so it is a shared base/interface vtable, not a per-class one

fields.name: allocator
fields.evidence: ctor copies owner[1] here; Field_InitSceneObjects passes {uVar12, memoryManager+0x344} as that argument, and Cutscene_ResolveActorResource forwards this word to Anim_KeyframeTrack_EvaluateAll, which hands it to Mem_AllocAligned as the pool

fields.name: sceneId
fields.evidence: ctor writes 0xFFFF; Cutscene_Init stores definition[0] here and looks the scene record up with it (func_0063D85C(dm, sceneId)); Cutscene_UpdateTimer passes it to Event_OnCutSceneEnd. struct_db dropped this offset from the batch

fields.name: sceneRecord
fields.evidence: Cutscene_Init stores func_0063D85C(dm, sceneId) here; every cutscene method guards on it and reads its bytes +0xC/+0xF/+0x10/+0x16/+0x19/+0x20 (layout mode, flags, layer type, next scene id)

fields.name: maybe_is3DScene
fields.evidence: Cutscene_Init sets it to 1 only when the scene record's +0xC byte is 1; Cutscene_LoadScenarioPacks loads the scenario packs only when it is set and Cutscene_Finish uses it to decide whether to drop the animation. struct_db dropped this offset from the batch

fields.name: is2DOverride
fields.evidence: Cutscene_Init copies definition byte 2 here; Cutscene_ApplyLayoutMode forces layout mode 0 and skips the 3D layer setup when it is non-zero

fields.name: maybe_enableCameraSteps
fields.evidence: Cutscene_Init copies definition byte 3 here; Cutscene_AdvanceTimeline tests it before every camera-step, sound and model-update branch, so it enables the per-frame camera/actor handling of the scene

fields.name: packHandle
fields.evidence: Cutscene_Init stores the scene pack handle here (Fs_NamedObject_LoadSimple + Pack_ReleaseHandle); Cutscene_ResolveActorResource resolves it with Container_HandleResolveAsType(&self->f_18) and Cutscene_Teardown frees it through the 0x007BA2D0 handle table

fields.name: resource
fields.evidence: Cutscene_ResolveActorResource stores Container_HandleResolveAsType(&self->f_18) here and passes it to Gfx_ResourceList_Attach; Cutscene_Teardown clears it

fields.name: maybe_taggedResource
fields.evidence: Cutscene_ResolveActorResource walks the resource list for the object whose type tag equals &g_tagTypeLookupTable and stores it here

fields.name: isTimerRunning
fields.evidence: Cutscene_ApplyLayoutMode sets it to 1 when it applies the layout; Cutscene_UpdateTimer uses it to choose between advancing the timeline (0) and counting down remainingTime

fields.name: remainingTime
fields.evidence: Cutscene_ApplyLayoutMode stores 0.5f (0x3F000000); Cutscene_UpdateTimer subtracts the frame delta and stores -1.0f (0xBF800000) when it expires; Cutscene_Teardown clears it

fields.name: animResource
fields.evidence: Cutscene_ResolveActorResource stores the tagged animation resource here and passes it as the context of Anim_KeyframeTrack_EvaluateAll; Cutscene_UpdateTimer advances the timeline while it is non-zero

fields.name: packHandles
fields.evidence: ctor sets it to self+0x40 (the inline storage); Cutscene_LoadScenarioPacks and Cutscene_AdvanceTimeline compute the count as (f_34-f_30)>>3 and walk 8-byte {handle, resource} entries

fields.name: packHandlesEnd
fields.evidence: ctor sets it to self+0x40; Cutscene_LoadScenarioPacks appends at f_34 and compares it with the capacity at f_38

fields.name: packHandlesCapacity
fields.evidence: ctor sets it to self+0x140, the end of the 32-entry inline storage; Cutscene_LoadScenarioPacks grows the vector when f_34 == f_38

fields.name: unknown_3c
fields.evidence: single write of 0 in the ctor, between the handle-vector capacity word and the inline storage; no reader recovered, so it is probably the small-vector's heap flag but that is unproven

fields.name: handleStorage
fields.evidence: ctor points the vector begin/end at self+0x40 and the capacity at self+0x140, i.e. 0x100 bytes = 32 8-byte {handle, resource} entries (64 words); Cutscene_Teardown walks them with Pack_ReleaseHandle

fields.name: handleCursor
fields.evidence: Cutscene_AdvanceTimeline: 'if (self[0x50] != (self[0xd]-self[0xc])>>3)' then processes entry begin+cursor*8 and increments it; Cutscene_FindResourceEntry bounds 'index < self->f_140'

fields.name: soundFileId
fields.evidence: Cutscene_ResolveActorResource stores the +0x58 word of the object found by its third tag lookup (tag &maybe_g_listPanelClassRecord) here; Cutscene_Close passes it to Sound_AllocFileSlot to (re)start the scene BGM

fields.name: soundHandle
fields.evidence: Cutscene_Close, Cutscene_Teardown and Cutscene_ReleaseMessageAndCamera release it with func_001EDD64(Sound_GetPlayer(), handle) and clear it; Cutscene_AdvanceTimeline plays it with func_001EE698(player, self[0x52])

fields.name: modelInstanceAnimData
fields.evidence: +0x14C starts an embedded Anim_ModelInstance (184 bytes, +0x14C..+0x204): Anim_ModelInstance_Release(&self->f_14c) frees *self and clears it, Anim_UpdateModelInstance(&self->f_53) updates it every frame

fields.name: unknown_150
fields.evidence: word 1 of the embedded model instance (Anim_ModelInstance+0x04); cleared by the ctor and by Anim_ModelInstance_Release, no reader recovered

fields.name: unknown_154
fields.evidence: word 2 of the embedded model instance (Anim_ModelInstance+0x08); cleared by the ctor and by Anim_ModelInstance_Release, no reader recovered

fields.name: modelAnimResource
fields.evidence: word 3 (Anim_ModelInstance+0x0C): Cutscene_AdvanceTimeline reads self[0x56] and dereferences ->f_60->f_c (the resource's entry count); Anim_ModelInstance_Release uses self[3] as the resource whose +0x60 header holds the u16 count at +0x12

fields.name: unknown_15c
fields.evidence: word 4 of the embedded model instance (Anim_ModelInstance+0x10); cleared by the ctor and by Anim_ModelInstance_Release, no reader recovered

fields.name: modelNodeStates
fields.evidence: word 5 (Anim_ModelInstance+0x14): Anim_Table_ClearActiveEntries(&self->f_14c) walks f_14 in 0x60-byte steps for resource->f_60->f_12 entries; Anim_ModelInstance_Release does the same with self[5]

fields.name: unknown_164
fields.evidence: word 6 of the embedded model instance (Anim_ModelInstance+0x18); cleared by the ctor and by Anim_ModelInstance_Release, no reader recovered

fields.name: unknown_168
fields.evidence: word 7 of the embedded model instance (Anim_ModelInstance+0x1C); cleared by the ctor and by Anim_ModelInstance_Release, no reader recovered
